europe_now.title: UK and EU Reach Landmark Agreement
europe_now.summary: The United Kingdom and the European Union have successfully concluded a landmark agreement aimed at resetting and rebuilding bilateral ties following Brexit. The diplomatic milestone addresses post-Brexit arrangements and establishes new frameworks for cooperation between the two sides.

sources.headline: UK and EU strike ‘landmark’ deal to rebuild ties after Brexit
What the new UK-EU deal could mean for future post-Brexit relations

europe_now.title: Cost of Living Protests Spread Across Europe
europe_now.summary: Mass demonstrations driven by economic pressures and cost-of-living concerns have broken out across multiple European countries, including widespread rallies in Spain. Activists and citizens are mobilizing to voice frustration over entrenched economic difficulties amidst broader regional challenges.

sources.headline: Gen Z protests spread across Europe: Mass rallies over cost of living in Spain

top_stories.title: French Police Officers Sentenced Over Brutal Assault
top_stories.summary: Several Paris police officers have been handed prison sentences following their involvement in the 2020 beating of music producer Michel Zecler. The high-profile judicial ruling addresses accountability for law enforcement misconduct within the capital.

top_stories.title: High-Profile Legal Investigations in France
top_stories.summary: French authorities have launched formal inquiries into actor Gérard Depardieu and writer Michel Houellebecq concerning allegations of sexual misconduct. These ongoing investigations add to a series of legal developments involving prominent cultural figures in the country.

top_stories.title: Logistics Acquisition Completed in Poland
top_stories.summary: A FedEx-led consortium has successfully completed a massive 7.8 billion euro takeover of Polish delivery giant InPost. The major commercial transaction marks a significant consolidation within the Central European delivery and logistics sector.
